category: # Free Humanoid Platform — Hand v0.1 reference BOM
# REFERENCE BOM — NOT VALIDATED BY PHYSICAL BUILD. All prices ~2026 retail USD at unit-quantity-1 academic pricing. Confirm vendor part numbers and prices before purchase.
# Architectural commitment: §9 #4 — synergy-reduced underactuated 5-finger hand (Pisa-IIT SoftHand class). Single motor drives 5 fingers via a synergy tendon network with passive return springs.

description: Maxon EC-i 30 brushless DC, 70 W, 24 V, flat-rotor; nom. torque 78 mNm, peak 750 mNm, no-load 7000 rpm
notes: estimate; confirm before purchase. Catalog ID format follows Maxon convention; verify exact 24V variant against current Maxon catalog.

description: Maxon GP 32 HP planetary head, ratio 14:1, single-stage, max continuous torque 4.5 Nm, max intermittent 6.25 Nm
notes: estimate; confirm before purchase. 14:1 is the nearest catalog ratio to the ~10:1 design target.

description: Maxon ENX 16 EASY incremental encoder, 1024 cpr, mounts to EC-i 30 rear shaft (housekeeping; AS5048A on output shaft is primary)
notes: estimate; confirm before purchase. Optional but recommended for commutation feedback in addition to magnetic encoder.

description: mjbots Moteus n1 brushless servo controller, CAN-FD, 6S–14S, 100A peak, integrated MCU and FOC firmware
notes: price confirmed from public mjbots listing as of 2026-Q1; verify before purchase.

description: XT30 power pigtail + 18 AWG silicone wire, 0.5 m for Moteus n1 power input
notes: estimate; confirm before purchase.

description: Molex PicoClasp 4-pin CAN-FD harness pigtail (Moteus n1 CAN connector mate)
notes: estimate; confirm before purchase.

description: AMS AS5048A 14-bit magnetic rotary encoder, SPI, with diametric magnet
notes: price confirmed approximately; verify before purchase. Used as absolute output-shaft position sensor on motor pulley spool.

description: 6 mm dia x 2.5 mm diametrically magnetized N35H magnet for AS5048A
notes: estimate; confirm before purchase.

description: Phidgets CZL635 micro load cell, 0–5 kgf, S-type, with cable terminator interface
notes: estimate; confirm before purchase. Inline at synergy tendon terminator to close the tension-control loop.

description: Sparkfun HX711 24-bit load-cell ADC breakout, I2C/serial out
notes: estimate; confirm before purchase.

description: Samson AmSteel-Blue 1.5 mm UHMWPE 12-strand braid, ~400 lb tensile, sold by the ft
notes: estimate; confirm before purchase. ~3 m total stock; pre-stretch before final routing. McMaster P/N is approximate — verify diameter match.

description: Honeywell Spectra HL-25, 25 lb test fishing line, 100 m spool (alternate / spare)

notes: estimate; confirm before purchase. One per phalanx joint (3 phalanges x 5 fingers = 15).

description: McMaster oil-impregnated SAE 841 bronze flanged sleeve bushing, 3 mm ID x 5 mm OD x 4 mm L
notes: estimate; confirm before purchase. Two per joint (both sides). Verify metric P/N — 8458K71 is the imperial line; confirm metric SKU at order time.

description: Lee Spring torsion spring, 0.040 in wire, 0.187 in OD, 90° free angle, music wire
notes: estimate; confirm before purchase. One per phalanx joint for passive open posture.

description: Smooth-On Dragon Skin 30 platinum-cure silicone, 30A durometer, trial pint kit (1 lb)

description: Smooth-On So-Strong skin-tone pigment, 1 oz

description: Smooth-On Sil-Poxy silicone-to-substrate adhesive, 1 oz tube
